title: Role-Playing LLM-Based Multi-Agent Support Framework for Detecting and Addressing Family Communication Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a Japanese parent-child dialogue corpus with scenarios featuring various parental expectations (e.g., academic excellence, gender norms, social comparison), using an LLM-based agent to extract and describe these implicit biases from parental utterances, and evaluating the quality of the generated bias descriptions via human rater judgments on a 5-point Likert scale.
